i.norm: Verifies that calling withIgnored() with an empty array on the default empty Value returns the exact same instance (no new object is created). Value.from(null) returns the EMPTY singleton. Passing an empty String array to withIgnored() results in no change to the ignored-properties set, so the method should return 'this' rather than constructing a new Value.
Value.from(null) returns the shared EMPTY singleton
Calling withIgnored with an empty array should be a no-op and return the same instance
